review_scope: Static review of the exact bounded invocation that runs holla_write_policy_preflight. This does not authorize or establish a trust record, Holla product launch, PTY journey, capture, expected-generation admission, or qualification.

preflight_contract.source_behavior: The ignored test calls prepare_holla_help_overlay_preflight and prints its prepared_only receipt. Source inspection confirms this helper reads and validates the suite, subject executables, expected_generation=null, trust absence, write policy, and capture paths; it does not run the product, PTY journey, create a capture, write trust, or admit expected data.
preflight_contract.test_binary_parent_binding: The helper and shared_journeys binaries are in the same immutable artifact-pair/deps directory; this preserves the test_binary_parent included in the policy digest for the later shared_journeys execution.
preflight_contract.trust_record: The request names the separate trust-record path; it was absent at review time.
preflight_contract.write_paths: The actual output roots are the empty capture-write/candidate and capture-write/reference directories. The receipt destination is capture-write/paired-holla-receipt.json. The protected roots include both historical source roots, both built Holla artifact roots, and the paired-run oracle. These paths are disjoint from the preflight capture outputs and from trust storage.
preflight_contract.fresh_outputs: The stdout, stderr, and result outputs are in the new r4 capture directory and were absent at review time; HOME and TMPDIR are private r4 directories.

limitations: This review is for the one read-only policy preflight invocation only.
The earlier r1/r2 preflight attempts remain failures and are not upgraded by this review.
A successful preflight result still requires separate review before a caller-trust record is created.
No final shared_journeys case was run or qualified by this review.
